records.name: Butler Selbstverständlich
records.biography_en: Makes disapproval available without requiring a spoken request. His HyperNorm tray carries the correct cup to the correct person. A dissonant card asks whether a tired stranger could have tea too. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Missbilligung wurde wortlos stattgegeben.

variant_notes.note_en: Makes disapproval available without requiring a spoken request.

records.name: Hausdienerin Bittegleich
records.biography_en: Has six instructions and only one pair of goo hands. Her brass key opens every HyperNorm cupboard except the one holding clear instructions. A dissonant card waits there with a spare question. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sechs Aufträge teilen sich zwei verfügbare Hände.

variant_notes.note_en: Has six instructions and only one pair of goo hands.

records.name: Kellner Gleichda
records.biography_en: Can carry a promise further than a full tray. His HyperNorm pad allows wanted or not wanted, never not yet sure. A dissonant card gently prolongs the order. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zusage ist bereits auf dem Weg.

variant_notes.note_en: Can carry a promise further than a full tray.

records.name: Bankettwart Restgedeck
records.biography_en: Knows there is something under the cover and hopes it is the right thing. His HyperNorm cloche hides the difference between what was ordered and what arrived. A dissonant card suggests asking before the reveal. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Inhalt entspricht zumindest einer Erwartung.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows there is something under the cover and hopes it is the right thing.

records.name: Stewardess Schwebezustand
records.biography_en: Keeps service level even when gravity has resigned. Her clipped cup survives every HyperNorm change of gravity. A dissonant card asks whether service can remain kind without remaining level. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Schwerkraft wurde aus dem Dienstplan genommen.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps service level even when gravity has resigned.

records.name: Kammerdiener Protokollnull
records.biography_en: Believes perfect service begins where common sense politely leaves. His HyperNorm towel is folded to a protocol nobody remembers writing. A dissonant card unfolds it for somebody who is cold. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Vernunft wurde höflich vom Dienst entbunden.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes perfect service begins where common sense politely leaves.
